It is a ceiling on gross rent (rent + tenant-paid utilities), not a promised rent: the PHA also caps rent at local comparable unassisted rents (rent reasonableness) and subtracts tenant-paid utilities. The voucher pays for the smaller of the family's voucher size and the unit's bedrooms, so extra bedrooms earn nothing.
